title: LIS Topic Boundaries & Labels
description: S05 Project 2 — Segment lectures into topics with boundary annotations
label_config:
<View>
  <Header value="Topic Boundary Labelling" />
  <Header value="Listen and mark where topics change. Label each segment." />
  <Audio name="audio" value="$audio" />
  <Header value="Mark topic boundaries on the timeline" />
  <RectangleLabels name="segments" toName="audio">
    <Label value="topic_start" background="#4CAF50" />
    <Label value="subtopic_start" background="#FFC107" />
    <Label value="transition" background="#2196F3" />
  </RectangleLabels>
  <Header value="Topic Label (for each segment)" />
  <TextArea name="topic_labels" toName="audio" rows="3" placeholder="List topic labels in order, one per segment..." />
  <Header value="Number of Topics" />
  <Number name="num_topics" toName="audio" min="1" max="50" />
</View>
